description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various models in terms of overall ROUGE-G score as a function of the number of training examples, with the x-axis representing the number of training examples on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 64, and the y-axis showing the overall ROUGE-G score, which ranges from 11.0 to 19.0. The plot includes six distinct lines, each corresponding to a different model or variant: PELMS (solid green line), Pegasus-X (dashed green line), Pegasus-X (5%) (dotted green line), Primera (solid red line), Primera (5%) (dashed red line), Centrum (solid yellow line), and Centrum (5%) (dotted yellow line). The PELMS model consistently achieves the highest ROUGE-G score across all training example sizes, starting at approximately 16.5 when the number of training examples is 0 and increasing to around 18.5 at 64 training examples. The Pegasus-X model shows a similar trend but with slightly lower scores, starting at about 15.5 and reaching around 17.5 at 64 training examples. The Pegasus-X (5%) variant follows a similar pattern but with even lower scores, starting at around 14.5 and increasing to about 16.5. The Primera model starts at approximately 15.0 and increases to around 17.5, while the Primera (5%) variant begins at about 14.5 and rises to around 16.5. The Centrum model starts at around 15.0 and increases to about 16.5, and the Centrum (5%) variant starts at approximately 14.5 and increases to around 16.0. The PELMS model demonstrates superior performance compared to all other models, particularly at higher numbers of training examples.
